summary_1line: Bhishma forms the Garuda battle array while the Pandavas counter with a half‑moon formation, leading to chaotic, brutal fighting across all divisions.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma stands at the beak of the vast Garuda-shaped Kaurava army as thousands of chariots, elephants, and banners spread out like wings behind him at dawn.
A thick cloud of dust covers the battlefield as chariots, elephants, cavalry, and infantry clash blindly, guided only by banners and shouted watchwords.
The battlefield is strewn with broken standards, weapons, and bodies while headless trunks still stand amid blood-soaked earth under a clearing sky.
